subject: Money
title: Nixon Closes the Gold Window
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Nixon Closes the Gold Window.

hook.text: On August 15, 1971, Nixon went on TV and ended the dollar's link to gold. The world changed overnight.

buildup.text: France was demanding gold for its dollars. America's reserves were draining. Something had to give.

discovery.text: Nixon's 'temporary' suspension became permanent. No currency on Earth has been backed by gold since.

twist.text: Economists call this the Nixon Shock. Money became pure trust—no metal, no backing, just belief.

climax.text: Every dollar, euro, and yen today is fiat: valuable because governments say so and people believe.

quiz.question: When did Nixon end the dollar's gold convertibility?
